Punjab Employees Protest; CM Seeks Parole for Hawara

Punjab government employees protested on Tuesday over demands for Dearness Allowance (DA) and the Old Pension Scheme (OPS). The protests have intensified pressure on the Mann government. Separately, Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann has written to the Governor seeking parole for Jagtar Singh Hawara.
